<set-variable name="selected-backend" value="@{
        var apiType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", "openai");
        var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "unknown");
        var models = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-models");
        var apiTypes = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-api-types");

        // Skip for non-LLM requests (GET operations like listing models)
        if (modelId == "non-llm-request" || modelId == "not-applicable") {
            return "non-llm-request";
        }

        // 1. Check if api-type has a backend override
        var apiTypeBackend = apiTypes?[apiType]?["backend"]?.ToString();
        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(apiTypeBackend)) {
            return apiTypeBackend;
        }

        // 2. Look up backend from model configuration
        var modelBackend = models?[modelId]?["backend"]?.ToString();
        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(modelBackend)) {
            return modelBackend;
        }

        return String.Empty;
    }" />

    
    <set-variable name="selected-backend" value="@{
        var selectedBackend = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty);

        // Skip RBAC for non-LLM requests
        if (selectedBackend == "non-llm-request") {
            return selectedBackend;
        }

        // If no backend found, keep empty for error handling below
        if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedBackend)) {
            return "ERROR_NO_MODEL";
        }

        var allowedPools = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowedBackendPools", String.Empty);

        // Empty allowedBackendPools = all pools allowed (no RBAC restriction)
        if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(allowedPools)) {
            return selectedBackend;
        }

        // Check if selected backend is in the allowed list
        var allowed = allowedPools.Split(',').Select(s => s.Trim()).Where(s => s.Length > 0);
        if (allowed.Any(a => a.Equals(selectedBackend, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) {
            return selectedBackend;
        }

        // Backend not allowed - try default
        var defaultPool = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("defaultBackendPool", String.Empty);
        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultPool)) {
            return defaultPool;
        }

        // No default available - RBAC restriction blocks access
        return "ERROR_NO_ALLOWED_POOLS";
    }" />

    
    <set-variable name="targetBackendPool" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty))" />

    
    
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty) == "non-llm-request")">
            
        
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty) == "ERROR_NO_MODEL")">
            
                @($"UAIG - No backend configured for model {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "not-set")} with API type {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", "not-set")}")
            
            
                
                
                    application/json
                
                @{
                    var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "unknown");
                    var models = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-models");
                    var supportedModels = models != null
                        ? String.Join(", ", models.Properties().Select(p => p.Name))
                        : "none";
                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("message", $"Model '{modelId}' is not supported. Supported models: {supportedModels}"),
                            new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                            new JProperty("code", "unsupported_model"),
                            new JProperty("param", "model")
                        ))
                    ).ToString();
                }
            
        
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty) == "ERROR_NO_ALLOWED_POOLS")">
            
                @($"UAIG - RBAC restriction: no allowed pools for model {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "not-set")}")
            
            
                
                
                    application/json
                
                @{
                    var modelId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "unknown");
                    var allowedPools = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowedBackendPools", String.Empty);
                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                            new JProperty("message", $"Access to model '{modelId}' is not allowed for this client. You do not have access to any backend pools supporting this model."),
                            new JProperty("type", "access_error"),
                            new JProperty("code", "backend_pool_access_forbidden"),
                            new JProperty("allowed_backend_pools", allowedPools)
                        ))
                    ).ToString();
                }
            
        
    

    
    <set-variable name="targetPoolType" value="@{
        var selectedBackend = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty);

        if (selectedBackend == "non-llm-request") {
            return "non-llm-request";
        }

        // Look through models to find pool type for the selected backend
        var models = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-models");
        if (models != null) {
            foreach (var prop in models.Properties()) {
                var modelBackend = prop.Value["backend"]?.ToString();
                if (modelBackend != null && modelBackend.Equals(selectedBackend, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                    return prop.Value["pool-type"]?.ToString() ?? "azure-openai";
                }
            }
        }

        // Check api-types for backend type
        var apiTypes = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-api-types");
        if (apiTypes != null) {
            foreach (var prop in apiTypes.Properties()) {
                var apiTypeBackend = prop.Value["backend"]?.ToString();
                if (apiTypeBackend != null && apiTypeBackend.Equals(selectedBackend, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                    return prop.Value["pool-type"]?.ToString() ?? "azure-openai";
                }
            }
        }

        return "azure-openai";
    }" />

    
    
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty) == "non-llm-request")">
            
        
        <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", String.Empty).StartsWith("ERROR_"))">
            
        
        
            
            <set-backend-service backend-id="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend"))" />

            
            
                <when condition="@{
                    var poolType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType", String.Empty);
                    return poolType == "azure-openai" || poolType == "ai-foundry";
                }">
                    
                    
                    
                        @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["msi-access-token"])
                    
                
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType", String.Empty) == "external")">
                    
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                        @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["msi-access-token"])
                    
                
            
        
    

    
        @($"UAIG - Backend '{context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", "not-set")}' (type: {context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("targetPoolType", "not-set")}) selected for model '{context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("model-id", "not-set")}' with API type '{context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("api-type", "not-set")}'")
